card.name: Partway through rare split words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of rare words that are split into several parts, such as drug names (donepezil, sofosbuvir, Prezista), Lao script letters, and long German or Malay words.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle or end piece of a drug name split into parts.

modes.label: Lao script letters
modes.description: Single Lao characters inside a motto or word.

modes.label: Long foreign words
modes.description: Middle of long German or Malay words.

card.plain: It fires on the middle of unusual words that are broken into small pieces, such as drug names and foreign script.
